ai_draft_feedback_ck.name: ai_draft_feedback_ck
ai_draft_feedback_ck.value: feedback IS NULL OR feedback IN ('up', 'down')

ai_draft_feedback_reason_ck.name: ai_draft_feedback_reason_ck
ai_draft_feedback_reason_ck.value: feedback_reason IS NULL OR (feedback = 'down' AND feedback_reason IN ('incorrect', 'incomplete', 'wrong_sources', 'tone', 'other'))

ai_draft_failed_has_reason_ck.name: ai_draft_failed_has_reason_ck
ai_draft_failed_has_reason_ck.value: "ai_draft"."status" NOT IN ('failed', 'blocked') OR "ai_draft"."error_code" IS NOT NULL

ai_draft_counts_ck.name: ai_draft_counts_ck
ai_draft_counts_ck.value: "ai_draft"."invalid_citation_count" >= 0 AND "ai_draft"."input_tokens" >= 0 AND "ai_draft"."output_tokens" >= 0 AND "ai_draft"."est_cost_micros" >= 0 AND ("ai_draft"."ttft_ms" IS NULL OR "ai_draft"."ttft_ms" >= 0) AND ("ai_draft"."latency_ms" IS NULL OR "ai_draft"."latency_ms" >= 0)

ai_usage_timing_ck.name: ai_usage_timing_ck
ai_usage_timing_ck.value: ("ai_usage"."latency_ms" IS NULL OR "ai_usage"."latency_ms" >= 0) AND ("ai_usage"."ttft_ms" IS NULL OR "ai_usage"."ttft_ms" >= 0)

eval_review_item_verdict_ck.name: eval_review_item_verdict_ck
eval_review_item_verdict_ck.value: verdict IS NULL OR verdict IN ('agree', 'disagree')

eval_review_item_note_ck.name: eval_review_item_note_ck
eval_review_item_note_ck.value: "eval_review_item"."note" IS NULL OR "eval_review_item"."verdict" IS NOT NULL

ticket_triage_priority_ck.name: ticket_triage_priority_ck
ticket_triage_priority_ck.value: priority IS NULL OR priority IN ('low', 'normal', 'high', 'urgent')

ticket_triage_priority_override_ck.name: ticket_triage_priority_override_ck
ticket_triage_priority_override_ck.value: priority_override IS NULL OR priority_override IN ('low', 'normal', 'high', 'urgent')

ticket_triage_sentiment_ck.name: ticket_triage_sentiment_ck
ticket_triage_sentiment_ck.value: sentiment IS NULL OR sentiment IN ('negative', 'neutral', 'positive')

ticket_triage_succeeded_complete_ck.name: ticket_triage_succeeded_complete_ck
ticket_triage_succeeded_complete_ck.value: "ticket_triage"."status" <> 'succeeded' OR ("ticket_triage"."category" IS NOT NULL AND "ticket_triage"."priority" IS NOT NULL AND "ticket_triage"."sentiment" IS NOT NULL AND "ticket_triage"."language" IS NOT NULL AND "ticket_triage"."confidence" IS NOT NULL AND "ticket_triage"."model" IS NOT NULL AND "ticket_triage"."prompt_version" IS NOT NULL)

workspace_settings_ranges_ck.name: workspace_settings_ranges_ck
workspace_settings_ranges_ck.value: "workspace_settings"."monthly_token_budget" >= 0 AND "workspace_settings"."triage_confidence_threshold" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "workspace_settings"."retrieval_min_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 1 AND "workspace_settings"."version" > 0
